title: Studies in Microscopical Science
citation: Arthur C. Cole, Studies in Microscopical Science, 4 vols. (London: Baillière, Tindall and Cox, 1883, 1884, 1886, 1887).
tags: Arthur C. Cole; slide series; subscription; mounting; teaching; circulation
note: A slide-locked publication in the literal sense: the serial combined illustrated printed studies with physical microscope preparations. Volume 1 comprised 52 weekly parts and an accompanying set of 52 slides; later volumes continued the series. It is a key object-text publication for studying the joint circulation of slides, mounting instruction, and printed description.

authors: Jean A. Tempère and Hippolyte Peragallo
title: Diatomées du Monde Entier: Collection Tempère et Peragallo
citation: Jean A. Tempère and Hippolyte Peragallo, Diatomées du Monde Entier: Collection Tempère et Peragallo, first edition / 8 supplements (Paris: Imp.-Tribout, 1889–1895), with accompanying numbered microscope slides.
tags: Tempère; Peragallo; diatoms; slide series; France; circulation; exsiccata
note: A numbered transnational diatom slide series with accompanying text and provenance tables. Harvard's Terry register explicitly links first-edition serial numbers and localities to the slide collection, making this a direct object-text source rather than a general diatom publication.

title: Las preparaciones histológicas de Santiago Ramón y Cajal (1852-1934): catalogación e investigación
